integrated_multimodal_description:
[Shot 1] A wide shot of a school gate at early morning. The iron gate is half-open, the ground covered with fallen plane tree leaves. Warm golden sunlight filters through the tree canopy above, casting dappled light spots that drift across the leaves. A single leaf spirals down from a branch and lands in the foreground. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed from the wide gate toward the leaves. Soft backlight, gentle morning haze, subtle Kodak Portra 400 film grain. 9:16 vertical aspect ratio.
